/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/fernway-current/build.py <<'PY'
import ctypes as C, html, pathlib
c=C.CDLL('libcairo.so.2')
class Ext(C.Structure): _fields_=[(n,C.c_double) for n in ['x_bearing','y_bearing','width','height','x_advance','y_advance']]
class Header(C.Structure): _fields_=[('type',C.c_int),('length',C.c_int)]
class Point(C.Structure): _fields_=[('x',C.c_double),('y',C.c_double)]
class Data(C.Union): _fields_=[('header',Header),('point',Point)]
class Path(C.Structure): _fields_=[('status',C.c_int),('data',C.POINTER(Data)),('num_data',C.c_int)]
def bind(n,rest,args):
 f=getattr(c,n); f.restype=rest; f.argtypes=args; return f
ptr=C.c_void_p; dbl=C.c_double; integer=C.c_int
surface=bind('cairo_image_surface_create',ptr,[integer,integer,integer])(0,1,1)
ctx=bind('cairo_create',ptr,[ptr])(surface)
bind('cairo_select_font_face',None,[ptr,C.c_char_p,integer,integer])(ctx,b'Noto Serif Display',0,1)
bind('cairo_set_font_size',None,[ptr,dbl])(ctx,100)
move=bind('cairo_move_to',None,[ptr,dbl,dbl]); textpath=bind('cairo_text_path',None,[ptr,C.c_char_p]); ext=bind('cairo_text_extents',None,[ptr,C.c_char_p,C.POINTER(Ext)])
# Optical spacing: F/e, r/n and w/a are tucked independently.
pen=0
kern=[-3,-1,-1,-2,-3,-2,0]
for i,ch in enumerate('Fernway'):
 move(ctx,pen,0); textpath(ctx,ch.encode()); e=Ext(); ext(ctx,ch.encode(),C.byref(e)); pen+=e.x_advance+kern[i]
p=bind('cairo_copy_path',C.POINTER(Path),[ptr])(ctx).contents
parts=[]; i=0
fmt=lambda v:f'{v:.2f}'.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
while i<p.num_data:
 h=p.data[i].header
 if h.type in [0,1]:
  q=p.data[i+1].point; parts.append(('M' if h.type==0 else 'L')+fmt(q.x)+' '+fmt(q.y))
 elif h.type==2:
  parts.append('C'+' '.join(fmt(v) for j in range(1,4) for v in (p.data[i+j].point.x,p.data[i+j].point.y)))
 elif h.type==3: parts.append('Z')
 i+=h.length
word=' '.join(parts)
# The three broad pinnae and upright stem form an F; all are one silhouette.
mark='M5 15V9C2.5 9 1 6.5 1 3C3.1 3 4.8 4.2 5 6V5C5 2.5 8 1 11 1H15C14.5 4.8 11 7 7 7V10C8.5 7.8 11 7 14 7C13.5 10.5 10.8 12 7 12V15Z'
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
logo=f'''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 {pen+151:.2f} 148\" width=\"{pen+151:.2f}\" height=\"148\" role=\"img\" aria-labelledby=\"title desc\">
  <title id=\"title\">Fernway</title>
  <desc id=\"desc\">A fern-shaped F beside the Fernway wordmark.</desc>
  <g fill=\"#713f35\">
    <path d=\"{mark}\" transform=\"translate(8 20) scale(6)\"/>
    <path d=\"{word}\" transform=\"translate(132 105)\"/>
  </g>
</svg>\\n'''
(root/'logo.svg').write_text(logo)
(root/'logo-reversed.svg').write_text(logo.replace('#713f35','#f2d8c7'))
(root/'mark.svg').write_text(f'''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" role=\"img\" aria-labelledby=\"title\">
  <title id=\"title\">Fernway</title>
  <style>path{{fill:#713f35}}@media(prefers-color-scheme:dark){{path{{fill:#f2d8c7}}}}</style>
  <path d=\"{mark}\"/>
</svg>\\n''')
print('word advance',pen,'logo width',pen+151)

item.text:
Created a fern-shaped “F” with a warm brown, literary wordmark. The icon is thickened for clarity at 16px and adapts to dark mode.
